card.name: Place after 'in' before a city name
card.fires_on: The word 'in' (or 'and' in a list) right before a city or place name such as London, Madrid or Washington. Also seen partway through proper names and before numbers in lists.

modes.label: Before numbers in lists
modes.description: A space or dash just before a number in a list or range.
